title: Width of clauses after padding
statement: Let a conjunctive normal form on $r+a$ sign variables have every clause of width $3$, and suppose its number of clauses is at most $K$ and $a+3\le K$. Every clause in the padded formula on $r+K$ sign variables has width $3$.
hypotheses_covered: The number of clauses is at most $K$
The clause belongs to the padded formula
